ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, and the only background color used across the system

pencil-gray.$description: Pencil Gray — Faded helper text and secondary metadata — recedes so primary content carries weight

diagramatika-display.$description: Oversized display headlines and landmark letters (the 80px V–A–C spread) — a custom geometric face held at weight 400, so the monumental size carries presence without bold weight, letting the letterforms do the work. Substitute: Space Grotesk or any wide geometric sans.

diagramatika-text.$description: Body prose, captions, navigation labels, and secondary headings — pairs with Display at a more human scale, keeping a single weight across the system. Substitute: Inter or Söhne.

arial.$description: Falls back for form controls and button labels where the custom face is unavailable; stays at weight 400 to preserve the flat typographic voice.
